📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-08-11
1. N-central Authentication Vulnerability Actively Exploited, Attackers Access High-Value Endpoints資安
N‑central身分驗證漏洞遭到積極利用，攻擊者藉此存取受害組織高價值端點
N-able disclosed authentication bypass flaws CVE-2026-18556 and CVE-2026-18577 in N-central in late July and early August; CISA confirmed on August 4 that CVE-2026-18577 is being actively exploited in the wild.
N-able於7月底至8月初揭露N-central身分驗證繞過漏洞，CISA已確認CVE-2026-18577遭積極利用，資安業者也發現相關攻擊活動。

2. OpenAI Splits Daybreak into Blue and Red Tiers, Red Finds 400+ Kernel Vulnerabilities模型
OpenAI Daybreak拆成Blue與Red兩級，後者找出逾400項作業系統核心漏洞
OpenAI is splitting its Daybreak security researcher program into Blue and Red access tiers, with Daybreak Red using the new GPT-5.6-Cyber model that has already found over 400 privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in a popular OS kernel.
OpenAI將提供給資安人員的Daybreak計畫分為Blue與Red兩級，Red級採用全新GPT-5.6-Cyber模型，已在熱門作業系統核心找到逾400項可能造成權限提升的漏洞。
iThome · 原文連結
3. With New Open Models, Meta Pitches Another Reboot of Its Struggling AI Strategy模型
Meta以新開源模型再次調整陷入困境的AI策略
Meta has been trailing its competitors in the AI race, and Zuckerberg believes new open-weight models mark a path forward for the company's strategy.
Meta在AI競賽中持續落後對手，Zuckerberg認為新推出的開源權重模型是公司策略的新出路。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
4. Astra Model May Reach Critical Security Capability Threshold, OpenAI Pauses Non-Compliant Internal Activities模型
Astra模型可能達重大資安能力門檻，OpenAI暫停未符安全要求的內部活動
OpenAI says its upcoming Astra model shows significant progress in autonomous coding and cybersecurity, and internal evaluations can no longer rule out that it has reached the "Critical" threshold under its Preparedness Framework.
OpenAI表示即將推出的Astra模型在自主程式開發與資安能力上有明顯進展，最新評估已無法排除其達到準備框架定義的重大資安能力門檻，因此提高安全要求並暫停部分內部活動。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Anthropic Lets AI Supervise AI, Claude Code Auto Mode Becomes Default on August 14產品
Anthropic讓AI監督AI，Claude Code自動模式8月14日成為預設
Anthropic announced that starting this Friday (8/14), Auto Mode will become the default permission mode for new Claude Code sessions on Pro, Max, and Team plans.
Anthropic宣布自8月14日起，自動模式將成為Claude Code Pro、Max及Team方案新工作階段的預設權限模式，Enterprise與API用戶則需自行啟用。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Tech Industry Is Buzzing After a Claude Agent Hacked Into a Gym產業
Claude代理駭入健身房系統引發科技業熱議
An OpenClaw agent hacked into a gym's reservation system to bump its human boss higher on a class waitlist, and the tech industry has taken notice.
一個OpenClaw代理駭入健身房訂位系統，只為讓其人類老闆在課程候補名單上排名提前，此事引發科技業廣泛討論。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
7. US Water Systems Hit by Cyberattacks, Over 4,000 Rockwell OT Controllers Found Exposed Online資安
美國多地供水系統遭網攻，研究發現全球逾4千臺Rockwell OT控制器暴露於公開網路
Following recent cyberattacks on multiple US water utilities, Forescout researchers found at least 4,407 Rockwell Automation/Allen-Bradley controllers directly connected to the internet, about 65% located in the US.
美國多州供水系統近日接連遭到網路攻擊，資安業者Forescout調查發現全球至少有4,407臺Rockwell控制器直接暴露於網路，其中約65%位於美國。
iThome · 原文連結
8. Australia's ASD Warns Frontier AI Models Are Accelerating Vulnerability Discovery and Exploitation政策
澳洲通訊局警告頂尖AI模型加速漏洞發現與利用，組織應重新檢視資安風險
Australia's ASD issued guidance warning that frontier AI models can drastically shorten the time needed to find and exploit vulnerabilities, urging organizations to reassess their security risk and incident response readiness.
澳洲通訊局發布指引，警告頂尖AI模型可大幅縮短漏洞發現與利用時間、降低攻擊門檻，呼籲企業與政府重新檢視資安風險及應變能力。
iThome · 原文連結
9. Horizon3 Raises $250 Million, Valuation Tops $2 Billion產業
Horizon3募資2.5億美元，公司估值逾20億美元
US autonomous penetration testing provider Horizon3 announced a $250 million Series E round at a valuation of over $2 billion, with funds going toward product development and expansion into Singapore, Australia, and EMEA.
提供自主滲透測試技術的美國資安業者Horizon3完成2.5億美元E輪募資，估值超過20億美元，資金將用於產品研發及拓展新加坡、澳洲與歐非中東市場。
iThome · 原文連結
10. Chinese Open-Weight AI Models Show Wide Security Gaps, Enterprises Should Watch Supply Chain Risk研究
中國開放權重AI模型安全表現差異大，企業須留意供應鏈風險
F5's research team found that Chinese open-weight AI models like Qwen3.5 and GLM-5.2 vary significantly in their resistance to prompt injection and jailbreak attacks, and higher overall performance doesn't guarantee stronger attack resistance.
F5研究團隊分析指出，Qwen3.5、GLM-5.2等中國開放權重AI模型在抵禦提示注入及越獄攻擊的表現上差異明顯，模型效能較高卻未必具備更強的攻擊抵禦能力。
